page.layout: Page number at top left. Above a rule: one table, years in the left margin, two name columns (Oppidani, Agrarij). Below a decorative band: a centred title, a centred subtitle, then two column headings ("Oppidani." and "Agrarij."). Below those: a second table, years in the left margin, two name columns. A partly cut-off "Idem" at lower right.

main_text.l: 1600 | Joannes Wichering, Eilardus Alma. | Wigboldus Byma solus.
1602 | Albertus Coenders, Goverd Everts, | Gerrijt Grabbe, Bernh. Sigers.
1603 | Albertus Coend. Albertus Jansen. | Bernh. Sigers, Wilhelm. Ubbena.
1604 | Eilard. Alma, Ludovicus Hornk. | Bernh. Sigers. Wilco tho Nansum[?].
1595 | Ioachimus Alting. | Ioan. Rengers tho Hellm[?].

page.notes: The ornamental band above the title is decoration, not text. The years are table cells in the left margin and belong to their rows. The name "Hellm" is set with a tilde-like mark, read as Hellm[?]. "Nansum" is set in a Fraktur-style capital N and is doubtful, marked [?]. The final "Idem" is cut off at the lower right edge of the scan and is read as Idem[?]. The page is cropped at the right edge, so some names may be partly missing.
